fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Access.Override
fields.Description: Parent grant for requesting exceptions to payment-gated access on an order. Child authorizations are WaivePaymentHold and DeferCutoff, one per override type. Holding the parent grants both. Who may approve a request is decided separately (bizapps-orders#360).

fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Access.Override.WaivePaymentHold
fields.Description: Request a WaivePaymentHold override on an order: its grants held for payment go Active before the payment arrives, through a stated last day. Requires a reason, and takes effect only once approved.

fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Access.Override.DeferCutoff
fields.Description: Request a DeferCutoff override on a renewal order: its grants stay Active past the renewal cutoff, through a stated last day. Requires a reason, and takes effect only once approved.
